sections.text:
SessionStart hook additional context: nauraiz-dev v0.2.5 · enforcement=advisory · state=none · no project config: run /nauraiz-dev:init (project) or /nauraiz-dev:setup (machine)
Task start: run /nauraiz-dev:start-task on the first substantive request (checks who owns the issue, asks before building, routes the process); to push and open a PR: /nauraiz-dev:ship.
superpowers is not installed or not enabled: run /nauraiz-dev:setup

- nauraiz-dev:implementer: Implements one task from a plan: failing test first, minimal code, verified before it reports. Dispatched by the build phase with one task per dispatch. Not for planning, review or open-ended exploration. (Tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash)
- nauraiz-dev:reviewer: Reviews a diff file read-only, in a fresh context, and returns review notes ranked by severity. Dispatched by the review skill with the path of the diff file. Not for editing code, fixing findings or approving a PR. (Tools: Read, Grep, Glob)
- nauraiz-dev:capture-lesson: Save a gotcha just hit (hang, timeout, blocked command, wrong path) as a dated lesson: 'remember that for next time'. Not for session notes (handoff), task lists, or things the code shows.
- nauraiz-dev:find-skills: Suggest installable skills for this project's stack: 'is there a skill for X', 'find skills'. Needs network, never installs. Not for writing a skill or using one already installed.
- nauraiz-dev:gate: Run the project's gate (its configured build, test and check commands) and report the real exit codes: before a report, a commit or a PR, or when asked to run the checks. Not for writing or fixing tests, or for one ad-hoc command.
- nauraiz-dev:grill: Ask the owner the few questions that change what gets built, before the plan: open decisions, shared paths, required approvals. Use from start-task or when asked to clarify a task. Not for small fixes or what the repo already answers.
- nauraiz-dev:handoff: Write or refresh the session handoff before stopping, compacting or switching machines: goal, done, next, open questions, files in play. Use when asked to hand off, wrap up, or when the PreCompact/Stop reminder appears. Not a commit or PR step.
- nauraiz-dev:kickoff-prompt: Write a kickoff prompt for an issue or task, for a fresh session here or elsewhere: guard block, branch, files, decisions, gate, stops, model, budget. Use when asked for a kickoff prompt. Not for doing the task.
- nauraiz-dev:memory-hygiene: Clean up project memory: 'clean up my memory', 'prune the knowledge files', MEMORY.md too long. Finds stale or relative-dated entries, dead file references. Not for adding a lesson (capture-lesson).
- nauraiz-dev:review: Review code before or in a PR: 'review my branch', 'check this before the PR', 'review PR #12'. Runs the reviewer agent on the diff and the gate; writes review notes, never an approval. Not for pushing or opening a PR (that is /nauraiz-dev:ship) or fixing findings.
- nauraiz-dev:start-task: Start work on an issue, branch or feature request: checks who owns the issue, asks before building, picks process and model, plans, builds, gates. Use on the first substantive request. Not for one-line fixes, typos, questions or PR review.
